simple.meaning: פַּרְעֹה (Parʻôh) appears 268 times in the Hebrew Scriptures as a person-name in the Hebrew text. The surrounding account also brings the name into conflict.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, beginning at Genesis 12:15. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to פַּרְעֹה (H6547) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows פַּרְעֹה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: פַּרְעֹה (Parʻôh) / H6547 is tracked through Genesis 12:15, Genesis 12:17, Genesis 12:18, Genesis 12:20. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.
